topology: 3 private-UDP replicas plus independent fourth-Pod generator
escalation: Stop after first rate with repeated non-clean outcomes or generator timing failure; optional extra lower-rate repeats remain separate.
capacityGate: Both repeats: all arrivals accepted, no unknown deadlines, no not-sent or business/server errors, generator timing valid, in-window goodput >=99% scheduled, all-offered p99 <=100ms. Report each failed condition.
scope: Finite-window deployed path; not production SLA, sustained capacity or physical-host fault-domain proof
faults: Separate configuration/lineage: kill owned leader JVM, elect successor, replay unchanged request, restart same three on-disk states, verify canonical snapshot and submit new trades
